description: This file defines a SQLiteRecordManager class implementing record management functionalities such as schema creation, key listing, existence checks, updates, and deletions, specifically for SQLite databases. It also includes a class for initializing and configuring the record manager, with methods for database schema setup and data source handling.

classes.name: SQLiteRecordManager_RecordManager
classes.description: Implements the INode interface, responsible for initializing and configuring the SQLite record manager based on node data and options.

classes.name: SQLiteRecordManager
classes.description: Implements RecordManagerInterface, providing methods for schema creation, key management, and data operations within a SQLite database.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the record manager instance based on node data and options, setting up database connection parameters.

methods.name: createSchema
methods.description: Creates the necessary database schema and indexes if they do not exist.

methods.name: getTime
methods.description: Retrieves the current timestamp from the SQLite database.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Upserts records into the database, updating timestamps and document IDs.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks whether specified keys exist in the database.

methods.name: listKeys
methods.description: Lists keys in the database with optional filters like time bounds, group IDs, and document ID.

methods.name: deleteKeys
methods.description: Deletes specified keys from the database.

methods.name: sanitizeTableName
methods.description: Sanitizes and validates table names to prevent SQL injection and ensure proper naming conventions.

methods.name: getDataSource
methods.description: Initializes and returns a TypeORM DataSource based on configuration options.
